doing_en: Scouting the old battlefield...
doing_zh: 正在察看旧战场……
done_en: Found strange footprints on the old battlefield.
done_zh: 在旧战场上发现了陌生的脚印。

doing_en: Following the footprints into the woods...
doing_zh: 正循着脚印走进树林……
done_en: Ran into a band of deserters at a forest camp.
done_zh: 在林中营地遇到了一伙逃兵。

doing_en: Squaring off with the deserters' leader...
doing_zh: 正在与逃兵头目交手……
done_en: Knocked the leader flat.
done_zh: 把头目打翻在地。

doing_kr: 깨어난 우두머리에게 선술집 이야기를 하는 중...
doing_en: Telling the leader about the tavern...
doing_zh: 正在向醒来的头目说起酒馆的事……
done_en: Told the deserters to come to the tavern.
done_zh: 吩咐逃兵们到酒馆来。

doing_en: Picking a fight at the dock tavern...
doing_zh: 正在码头酒肆里寻衅……
done_en: Got into a brawl at the dock tavern.
done_zh: 在码头酒肆打了一架。

doing_en: Trading blows with a sailor who joined in...
doing_zh: 正在和插手斗殴的水手较量……
done_en: Traded blows with the sailor for a long while.
done_zh: 和水手扭打了好一阵。

doing_kr: 뱃사람과 부서진 탁자값을 나눠 내는 중...
doing_en: Splitting the bill for the broken table...
doing_zh: 正在和水手分摊砸坏的桌子钱……
done_en: Learned the sailor was a former marine.
done_zh: 听说那水手是水军出身。

doing_kr: 해병에게 뭍에서 일할 생각을 묻는 중...
doing_en: Asking the marine about work on land...
doing_zh: 正在问水军老兵有没有上岸做事的打算……
done_en: The marine said they would stop by the tavern.
done_zh: 水军老兵说会到酒馆来一趟。

doing_kr: 국경 초소에서 지원병 명부를 넘겨보는 중...
doing_en: Reading the muster roll at the border post...
doing_zh: 正在边境哨所翻阅志愿兵名册……
done_en: Found a discharged spearman in the roll.
done_zh: 在名册上找到了一名退役枪兵的名字。

doing_kr: 창병이 산다는 산골 마을로 가는 중...
doing_en: Heading to the spearman's mountain village...
doing_zh: 正前往枪兵居住的山村……
done_kr: 산골 마을에서 장작을 패는 창병을 찾았다.
done_en: Found the spearman chopping firewood.
done_zh: 在山村里找到了正在劈柴的枪兵。

doing_en: Challenging the spearman to a bout...
doing_zh: 正在约枪兵比试一场……
done_en: Fought the spearman to a draw.
done_zh: 与枪兵交手，打成了平手。

doing_kr: 비긴 김에 창병에게 술을 사는 중...
doing_en: Buying the spearman a drink after the draw...
doing_zh: 既然打平了，正顺势请枪兵喝酒……
done_en: Agreed to a rematch at the tavern.
done_zh: 约好在酒馆再比一场。

doing_kr: 도박장에서 판돈 큰 탁자를 살피는 중...
doing_en: Eyeing the big tables at the gambling den...
doing_zh: 正在赌坊里打量赌注大的桌子……
done_en: Found a sellsword drowning in gambling debt.
done_zh: 在赌坊找到一个债台高筑的佣兵。

doing_en: Buying up the sellsword's debts...
doing_zh: 正在收购佣兵的借据……
done_en: Bought the debts for a pittance.
done_zh: 以低价买下了借据。

doing_kr: 빚을 덜어 줄 조건을 흥정하는 중...
doing_en: Haggling over terms to clear the debt...
doing_zh: 正在商谈减免债务的条件……
done_kr: 빚을 깎아 주고 계약서에 서명을 받았다.
done_en: Cut the debt in exchange for a signed contract.
done_zh: 减了些债，换来了契约上的签名。

doing_en: Carrying the contract back to the tavern...
doing_zh: 正带着契约返回酒馆……
done_en: Left the contract with the tavern keeper.
done_zh: 把契约交给了酒馆老板。

doing_en: Scanning the bounty board in the square...
doing_zh: 正在浏览广场上的悬赏告示板……
done_kr: 현상금이 가장 큰 수배지를 떼어 냈다.
done_en: Tore down the poster with the biggest bounty.
done_zh: 揭下了赏金最高的通缉令。

doing_kr: 같은 수배범을 쫓는 사냥꾼을 찾는 중...
doing_en: Looking for hunters on the same trail...
doing_zh: 正在寻找追捕同一名通缉犯的猎人……
done_en: Met two bounty hunters at the harbor.
done_zh: 在港口遇到了两名赏金猎人。

doing_en: Arguing over how to split the reward...
doing_zh: 正在计较赏金的分成……
done_en: Agreed on a three-way split.
done_zh: 三人联手，说好一起分赏金。

doing_en: Pitching the tavern as a base of operations...
doing_zh: 正在劝猎人们把酒馆当作据点……
done_en: Settled on the tavern as their base.
done_zh: 说定以酒馆为据点。

doing_en: Browsing the blades at the pawnshop...
doing_zh: 正在当铺里翻看典当的刀剑……
done_en: Found a sword with a name carved in it.
done_zh: 在当铺找到了一把刻着名字的剑。

doing_kr: 전당포 주인에게 칼 주인을 캐묻는 중...
doing_en: Pressing the pawnbroker about the owner...
doing_zh: 正在向当铺老板追问剑的主人……
done_kr: 칼 주인이 노름빚에 칼을 잡혔다고 들었다.
done_en: Heard the owner pawned it over gambling debts.
done_zh: 听说剑的主人为了还赌债把剑当掉了。

doing_kr: 칼을 사 들고 주인을 찾아가는 중...
doing_en: Buying the sword and tracking down its owner...
doing_zh: 正买下剑去找它的主人……
done_en: Found the owner at a back-alley inn.
done_zh: 在后巷的旅店里找到了剑的主人。

doing_en: Haggling to have the sword paid off in work...
doing_zh: 正在商量让对方用干活来抵剑钱……
done_kr: 칼 주인이 선술집 일로 갚기로 했다.
done_en: The owner agreed to work it off at the tavern.
done_zh: 剑的主人答应在酒馆干活抵债。

doing_en: Slipping into a noble's banquet...
doing_zh: 正悄悄混进贵族的宴会……
done_en: Found a dance partner at the banquet.
done_zh: 在宴会厅里找到了舞伴。

doing_kr: 춤 상대에게 손님들 이야기를 듣는 중...
doing_en: Hearing gossip about the guests...
doing_zh: 正在听舞伴讲宾客们的事……
done_kr: 칼을 잘 쓰는 호위 기사 이야기를 들었다.
done_en: Heard of a bodyguard skilled with a blade.
done_zh: 听说有位剑术高明的护卫骑士。

doing_kr: 정원에서 호위 기사에게 말을 거는 중...
doing_en: Chatting up the bodyguard in the garden...
doing_zh: 正在花园里与护卫骑士搭话……
done_en: Talked with the bodyguard late into the night.
done_zh: 和护卫骑士一直聊到深夜。

doing_kr: 호위 기사에게 선술집 이름을 적어 주는 중...
doing_en: Writing the tavern's name for the bodyguard...
doing_zh: 正在给护卫骑士写下酒馆的名字……
done_en: Agreed to meet again at the tavern.
done_zh: 约好在酒馆再见。

doing_en: Waiting backstage at the theater...
doing_zh: 正在剧院后台等演员们……
done_en: Met the actor who plays the sword fights.
done_zh: 见到了负责剑斗戏的演员。

doing_kr: 배우에게 진짜 칼을 쥐여 보는 중...
doing_en: Handing the actor a real blade...
doing_zh: 正让演员握一握真剑……
done_en: The actor's swordwork turned out to be real.
done_zh: 演员的剑术是真功夫。

doing_en: Asking about the actor's past...
doing_zh: 正在打听演员的过往……
done_en: Heard the actor used to be a sellsword.
done_zh: 听说演员当过佣兵。

doing_kr: 배우에게 무대 밖 일을 권하는 중...
doing_en: Offering the actor work off the stage...
doing_zh: 正在劝演员接些台下的活……
done_en: The actor will visit the tavern after the show.
done_zh: 说好演出结束后到酒馆坐坐。

doing_en: Listening to talk at the bathhouse...
doing_zh: 正在公共浴场听人们闲聊……
done_en: Picked up plenty of town news at the bathhouse.
done_zh: 在浴场听到了一大堆镇上的消息。

doing_kr: 소문 속 떠돌이 음유시인을 찾는 중...
doing_en: Looking for the bard from the gossip...
doing_zh: 正在寻找传闻中的流浪吟游诗人……
done_en: Found the bard by the fountain in the square.
done_zh: 在广场的喷泉边找到了吟游诗人。

doing_en: Listening to the bard's song to the end...
doing_zh: 正把吟游诗人的歌听到最后……
done_kr: 노래 속 영웅들의 이름을 받아 적었다.
done_en: Wrote down the names of the heroes in the song.
done_zh: 记下了歌中英雄们的名字。

doing_en: Asking around about the names...
doing_zh: 正在四处打听记下的名字……
done_kr: 그중 하나가 선술집 단골이라는 걸 알았다.
done_en: Learned one of them drinks at the tavern.
done_zh: 得知其中一人是酒馆的常客。

doing_kr: 건너편 선술집 손님 수를 세는 중...
doing_en: Counting heads at the tavern across the way...
doing_zh: 正在数对面酒馆的客人……
done_en: The rival tavern had more customers.
done_zh: 对面酒馆的客人更多。

doing_kr: 손님인 척 건너편 선술집에 들어가는 중...
doing_en: Walking into the rival tavern as a customer...
doing_zh: 正装作客人走进对面的酒馆……
done_en: Took note of the regulars there.
done_zh: 记下了那边的常客佣兵。

doing_kr: 단골 용병에게 더 나은 대우를 귀띔하는 중...
doing_en: Whispering better terms to a regular...
doing_zh: 正向常客佣兵透露更好的待遇……
done_en: One sellsword seemed tempted.
done_zh: 有个佣兵动了心。

doing_kr: 그 용병에게 우리 선술집 길을 알려 주는 중...
doing_en: Showing the sellsword the way to our tavern...
doing_zh: 正在给那个佣兵指去我们酒馆的路……
done_en: Pointed the sellsword to our tavern.
done_zh: 告诉了对方去我们酒馆的路。

doing_en: Spying on a famous mercenary company...
doing_zh: 正在窥探知名佣兵团的住处……
done_en: Got a look at the company's roster.
done_zh: 偷看到了佣兵团的出入名单。

doing_en: Picking underpaid names from the roster...
doing_zh: 正从名单里挑出受冷落的团员……
done_en: Picked out three overlooked members.
done_zh: 挑好了三个受冷落的团员。

doing_kr: 골라 둔 단원들에게 몰래 쪽지를 건네는 중...
doing_en: Slipping notes to the chosen members...
doing_zh: 正偷偷给挑好的团员递纸条……
done_en: One of them wrote back.
done_zh: 有个团员回了信。

doing_kr: 답장에 적힌 여관에서 단원을 기다리는 중...
doing_en: Waiting at the inn named in the reply...
doing_zh: 正在回信里写的旅店等那名团员……
done_en: Passed our terms to the member.
done_zh: 向那名团员转达了我们这边的条件。

doing_kr: 용병 길드에서 남이 받은 의뢰를 훔쳐보는 중...
doing_en: Peeking at who took which job at the guild...
doing_zh: 正在佣兵公会偷看别人接下的委托……
done_kr: 가장 비싼 의뢰를 받은 무리를 알아냈다.
done_en: Found out who took the best-paying job.
done_zh: 打听到了接下最贵委托的那伙人。

doing_en: Tailing that crew...
doing_zh: 正在跟踪那伙人……
done_en: Found the inn where the crew is staying.
done_zh: 查到了那伙人投宿的旅店。

doing_en: Eavesdropping on the crew at the inn...
doing_zh: 正在旅店里偷听那伙人的谈话……
done_kr: 무리의 궁수가 불만이 많다는 걸 알았다.
done_en: Learned their archer is unhappy.
done_zh: 得知那伙人的弓箭手满腹牢骚。

doing_en: Buying the archer a drink on the side...
doing_zh: 正单独请那名弓箭手喝酒……
done_en: Told the archer to come to the tavern.
done_zh: 吩咐弓箭手到酒馆来。

doing_en: Dozing by the river with a fishing line out...
doing_zh: 正在河边垂着钓竿打盹……
done_en: Got talking with the angler at the next spot.
done_zh: 和旁边的钓客搭上了话。

doing_kr: 낚시꾼의 긴 이야기를 들어 주는 중...
doing_en: Listening to the angler's long stories...
doing_zh: 正在听钓客讲冗长的往事……
done_en: Heard the angler once taught the spear.
done_zh: 听说钓客当年是枪术教头。

doing_en: Bringing up work with the old master...
doing_zh: 正向教头提起差事……
done_en: The master said they would think it over.
done_zh: 教头说会考虑考虑。

doing_kr: 낚싯대를 걷고 사범과 마을로 걷는 중...
doing_en: Walking back to town with the master...
doing_zh: 正收起钓竿，和教头一起走回镇上……
done_en: Showed the master where the tavern is.
done_zh: 告诉了教头酒馆在哪儿。

doing_en: Sleeping in at the inn...
doing_zh: 正在旅店床上睡懒觉……
done_en: Got up around noon.
done_zh: 快到中午才起床。

doing_kr: 여관 주인에게 소문을 모아 달라고 하는 중...
doing_en: Asking the innkeeper to collect the rumors...
doing_zh: 正在托旅店老板帮忙收集传闻……
done_kr: 여관 주인이 적어 둔 소문 쪽지를 받았다.
done_en: Got a sheaf of rumor notes from the innkeeper.
done_zh: 收到了旅店老板记下的传闻纸条。

doing_en: Reading the notes in bed...
doing_zh: 正躺在床上读纸条……
done_kr: 쪽지에서 일을 찾는 떠돌이 검사를 찾았다.
done_en: Found a wandering swordsman looking for work.
done_zh: 从纸条里找到一位正在找活干的流浪剑士。

doing_en: Sending an errand boy to the swordsman...
doing_zh: 正派跑腿的去找流浪剑士……
done_en: Sent the tavern's location by errand boy.
done_zh: 托跑腿的把酒馆的位置捎了过去。

doing_en: Soaking up the sun on a bench in the square...
doing_zh: 正在广场长椅上晒太阳……
done_en: Watched people go by for half a day.
done_zh: 看了大半天来往的行人。

doing_kr: 같은 길을 세 번 지나간 사람을 눈여겨보는 중...
doing_en: Eyeing someone who passed by three times...
doing_zh: 正留意一个在同一条路上走了三遍的人……
done_en: Spotted a lost pilgrim knight.
done_zh: 认出了一位迷路的朝圣骑士。

doing_kr: 앉은 채로 순례 기사에게 길을 알려 주는 중...
doing_en: Giving directions without getting up...
doing_zh: 正坐着给朝圣骑士指路……
done_kr: 순례 기사가 옆에 앉아 쉬어 갔다.
done_en: The knight sat down for a rest.
done_zh: 朝圣骑士在旁边坐下歇了歇脚。

doing_kr: 순례 기사와 나란히 낮잠을 자는 중...
doing_en: Napping on the bench with the knight...
doing_zh: 正和朝圣骑士并排睡午觉……
done_en: Woke up and agreed to meet at the tavern.
done_zh: 醒来后约好在酒馆见。

doing_en: Eating skewers in the food alley...
doing_zh: 正在小吃街吃烤串……
done_kr: 꼬치 장수에게서 덩치 큰 도끼꾼 이야기를 들었다.
done_en: The skewer seller told of a big axeman.
done_zh: 从卖烤串的那里听说了一个身材魁梧的斧手。

doing_kr: 도끼꾼이 자주 간다는 국밥집을 찾는 중...
doing_en: Finding the axeman's favorite stew house...
doing_zh: 正在找斧手常去的汤饭馆……
done_en: Found the axeman at the stew house.
done_zh: 在汤饭馆找到了斧手。

doing_kr: 도끼꾼과 한 상에서 국밥을 먹는 중...
doing_en: Sharing a table and a stew with the axeman...
doing_zh: 正和斧手同桌吃汤饭……
done_en: Paid for the axeman's stew.
done_zh: 替斧手付了汤饭钱。

doing_en: Offering work to the well-fed axeman...
doing_zh: 正在向吃饱了的斧手推荐差事……
done_en: The axeman said they would stop by the tavern.
done_zh: 斧手说会到酒馆来一趟。

doing_en: Entering the festival eating contest...
doing_zh: 正去参加节庆上的比吃大赛……
done_en: Took second place in the eating contest.
done_zh: 在比吃大赛中拿了第二名。

doing_en: Talking to the giant who took first...
doing_zh: 正在和拿了第一的大块头搭话……
done_en: Heard the giant used to guard the city gate.
done_zh: 听说大块头当过城门守卫。

doing_en: Treating the giant to dinner...
doing_zh: 正请大块头吃晚饭……
done_en: Ate dinner with the giant twice over.
done_zh: 和大块头吃了两顿晚饭。

doing_kr: 거구에게 선술집 안주 자랑을 하는 중...
doing_en: Bragging about the tavern's food to the giant...
doing_zh: 正在向大块头夸耀酒馆的下酒菜……
done_kr: 거구가 선술집 안주를 먹으러 오겠다고 했다.
done_en: The giant will come to try the tavern's food.
done_zh: 大块头说要来酒馆尝尝下酒菜。

doing_kr: 고기 굽는 냄새를 따라 사냥터로 가는 중...
doing_en: Sniffing out a roast at the hunting grounds...
doing_zh: 正循着烤肉的香味走向猎场……
done_en: Got fed at a hunters' camp.
done_zh: 在猎人营地蹭到了肉吃。

doing_en: Hearing the hunters' stories...
doing_zh: 正在听猎人们讲狩猎的故事……
done_kr: 늑대 떼를 혼자 쫓아낸 사냥꾼 이야기를 들었다.
done_en: Heard of a hunter who drove off wolves alone.
done_zh: 听说有个猎人独自赶走了狼群。

doing_en: Visiting that hunter's lodge...
doing_zh: 正前往那位猎人的小屋……
done_en: Shared jerky with the hunter in the lodge.
done_zh: 在小屋里和猎人分着吃了肉干。

doing_en: Selling the hunter on the tavern's cooking...
doing_zh: 正向猎人推荐酒馆的饭菜……
done_kr: 사냥꾼이 장 보러 나올 때 들르기로 했다.
done_en: The hunter will drop in on the next town trip.
done_zh: 猎人说下次进城赶集时会顺道过来。

doing_en: Handing a reference to the knights' hall...
doing_zh: 正向骑士团总部递上推荐信……
done_en: Sat down across from the knight commander.
done_zh: 与骑士团长相对而坐。

doing_en: Telling the commander about past exploits...
doing_zh: 正在向骑士团长大谈自己的英勇事迹……
done_en: The commander heard it all the way through.
done_zh: 骑士团长一直听到了最后。

doing_kr: 기사단장에게 쓸 만한 기사를 묻는 중...
doing_en: Asking the commander for capable knights...
doing_zh: 正向骑士团长打听可用的骑士……
done_en: Was introduced to a knight close to retiring.
done_zh: 经引荐认识了一位即将退隐的骑士。

doing_kr: 은퇴 기사에게 마지막 원정을 권하는 중...
doing_en: Urging the old knight to one last campaign...
doing_zh: 正在劝退隐骑士参加最后一次远征……
done_kr: 은퇴 기사가 선술집에서 답을 주겠다고 했다.
done_en: The old knight will answer at the tavern.
done_zh: 退隐骑士说会在酒馆给出答复。

doing_kr: 광장에 나가 결투 상대를 찾는 중...
doing_en: Calling for challengers in the square...
doing_zh: 正在广场上寻找决斗对手……
done_kr: 광장에서 결투 신청을 세 번 받았다.
done_en: Took three challenges in the square.
done_zh: 在广场上接下了三次决斗挑战。

doing_en: Fighting the duels one by one...
doing_zh: 正在逐一进行决斗……
done_en: Won all three.
done_zh: 三场全胜。

doing_en: Asking the losers their names...
doing_zh: 正在询问落败者的名字……
done_kr: 진 상대 가운데 방패 솜씨 좋은 이를 봐 두었다.
done_en: Marked one loser as a skilled shield fighter.
done_zh: 在落败者中留意到一个盾术出色的人。

doing_en: Inviting the shield fighter to ride along...
doing_zh: 正邀那位持盾者结伴同行……
done_en: Told the shield fighter to come to the tavern.
done_zh: 让持盾者到酒馆来找。

doing_en: Looking up fallen houses at the heralds' hall...
doing_zh: 正在纹章院查找没落的家族……
done_en: Found the heir of a fallen knightly house.
done_zh: 找到了没落骑士家族的后人。

doing_kr: 성 밖 후손의 오두막으로 가는 중...
doing_en: Heading to the heir's hut outside the walls...
doing_zh: 正前往城外后人的小屋……
done_en: Found the heir polishing rusted armor.
done_zh: 见到了正在擦拭锈甲的后人。

doing_kr: 후손에게 가문을 다시 일으키자고 하는 중...
doing_en: Urging the heir to restore the house...
doing_zh: 正劝后人重振家门……
done_en: The heir took down the family sword.
done_zh: 后人取出了家传的剑。

doing_kr: 후손에게 선술집에서 이름을 알리라고 권하는 중...
doing_en: Telling the heir to earn a name at the tavern...
doing_zh: 正劝后人在酒馆闯出名号……
done_en: The heir will sign up at the tavern.
done_zh: 后人说会去酒馆留下名字。
